title: fix(pm): the queue guard and governed register read paths with -z, so a non-ASCII or newline path stays governed
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XXh5WtVCVVwVPwHeJRQd1Js)_ Fixes #33620 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Signed: domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mbkhYE1nRMP6v8ysa ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:合并队列守卫(`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `enumerateRows`)和受管登记脚本(`check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `--branch`、事后审计、workflow 拆分)读文件路径时一律加 `-z`、按 NUL 切分。 - 为什么改:不加 `-z` 时,git 会把含中文等非 ASCII 字符、引号或换行的路径打印成带引号的转义串,它对不上任何受管前缀,队列守卫因此看不见这个受管文件,会把它当成普通文件放行。 - 风险与回滚:只改 `scripts/pm/**` 两个工具脚本及其自测,外加 fleet-write 执行器自测里的一个 git 假件(随新参数移位);不发布任何包;所有 ASCII 路径的判定字节不变。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看:`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `enumerateRows`;`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `deriveBranchPaths` 与 `commitChanges`。 - 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`,预期 530 条全过(含 3 条 #33620 真 git 用例)。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地(非受管面,达档复核后由席位入队)。 ## What changes Every path listing that feeds a governed match now reads `-z` and splits on NUL. Without `-z` git C-quotes a path holding a non-ASCII byte, a quote or a control character (`"skills/a/\346\226\207.md"`, `"skills/a/two\nlines.md"`), and the quoted spelling starts with a quote mark, so it matches no governed prefix: the queue leg never saw that governed file. | File | Read | Was | Now | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` | `enumerateRows`, `pull_request` net row | `diff-tree … --name-only base head`, split on newline | `… --name-only -z …`, split on NUL | | `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` | `enumerateRows`, `merge_group` per-commit row | `diff-tree … --name-only -m --first-parent sha`, split on newline | `… -z …`, split on NUL | | `check-governed-merges.mjs` | `deriveBranchPaths` (`--branch`) | `diff --name-only --no-renames`, split on newline and trimmed | `diff -z …`, split on NUL, not trimmed per path | | `check-governed-merges.mjs` | `commitChanges` (the sweep's path list) | `diff-tree --numstat`, one record per line | `diff-tree --numstat -z`, one `added TAB deleted TAB path` record per NUL | | `check-governed-merges.mjs` | `readWorkflowDiff` `listAt` (the workflow split's base/head/inventory listing) | `ls-tree -r --name-only`, split on newline and trimmed | `ls-tree -r -z --name-only`, split on NUL | Surface breach, named: `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` is outside the claim's file surface. Its self-test drives `readWorkflowDiff` through an `ls-tree` fake that read the revision at `argv[3]`, the directories from `argv.slice(5)` and joined names with a newline; the new `-z` argv moved both one index, so `check:pm-fleet-write-execute` went red (2 of 415, review record 6893545108, M1). The fake now reads `argv[4]` / `argv.slice(6)` and joins with NUL: test code only, the same three-line move as the two fakes in this PR's own files. The executor's production `governedReviewPlan` reaches `readWorkflowDiff` too, so the relay's workflow reading takes `-z` with this PR. The arm's own `catalogFilesOf` (`diff-tree --raw -z`) and the carried-head read (`diff -z --name-only`) already used `-z`; the path walk now spells each path the way they do, so a catalog path with such a name has its status row instead of reading "no status was read". Not changed, on purpose: the two size reads (`diff --numstat -M` in `--branch`, `diff-tree -M --numstat` in the sweep) only sum the two counts, which quoting never touches; `pullCatalogReading`'s `ls-tree sha -- path` parses the mode only. The `--branch` derivation line now prints `git diff -z --name-only --no-renames …`, the command that ran. ## Tests Self-test fakes moved with the argv (`-z` in the recorded reads, NUL-joined answers, the `ls-tree` fakes' argv indices), and new real-git rows through `gitFreeEnv()`: - `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: 526 → 530 cases, exit 0. On a real repo with `skills/a/文档.md` and `skills/a/two` NEWLINE `lines.md`: a CONTROL row proves the plain read quotes both and matches nothing governed; `merge_group` and `pull_request` rows each read both paths raw, both governed, attributed to the PR; `catalogFilesOf` spells both paths the way the walk does. - `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-execute`: 415 / 415, exit 0 on f1a04f78. With the old fake restored on disk (`argv[3]`, through `ablation-replace`) it reads exactly the review's red: 2 of 415, `tier-s-workflow-pull-requests-no-one` and `h-reading-workflow-pull-requests`, `fatal: not a tree object`. Every other importer of the two files ran its self-test green on f1a04f78: `check:pm-fleet-write-validate`, `check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, `check:pm-post-stamped`, `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check-handover`, `fleet-write/ops`, `check-closing-target-claim`, `check-skills-token-ratchet`. - `check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: 741 → 745 assertions, exit 0. On a real repo with the same two names plus `.github/workflows/café.yml` edited: a CONTROL row (the plain list quotes all three, none governed); `--branch` and `commitChanges` (run under `withoutGitEnv`) read all three raw, all governed; `readWorkflowDiff` finds the non-ASCII workflow at both commits and classifies the edit instead of reading it "absent at both commits". `scripts/git-env.mjs` joins the uninstalled-checkout fixture's copied module graph, since the file now imports it.
Ablation: each -z dropped on disk, each row red, each restored (head c5d1fddd) Every mutation through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hits 1 → 0 on disk, blob changed; restore: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), with a shell `trap` restoring both files from `HEAD`. ```text guard, merge_group read -z dropped -> exit 1, 2 of 530 failed: ⛔ #33620-merge_group-reads-a-non-ASCII-and-a-newline-path-raw-and-each-is-GOVERNED #33620-the-arm-status-read-spells-each-path-as-the-path-walk-does-so-every-path-has-its-row guard, pull_request read -z dropped -> exit 1, 2 of 530 failed: and-it-reads-the-net-diff-base-to-head-never-a-per-commit-first-parent-diff (the argv pin) ⛔ #33620-pull_request-reads-the-same-two-paths-raw-and-each-is-GOVERNED merges, --branch read -z dropped (fake keys held without -z too, so the run reaches the real-git rows) -> exit 1, 4 failed: ⛔ #33620 --branch-reads-a-non-ASCII-and-a-newline-path-raw-and-each-is-GOVERNED ⛔ #33620 the-workflow-split-lists-a-non-ASCII-workflow-at-BOTH-commits-and-classifies-the-edit plus two older real-git rows that read the NUL-split list merges, commitChanges -z dropped -> exit 1, 5 failed, among them: ⛔ #33620 the-sweep-commitChanges-reads-the-same-paths-raw-and-each-is-GOVERNED merges, workflow ls-tree -z dropped (fake argv indices held in step) -> exit 1, exactly 1 failed: ⛔ #33620 the-workflow-split-lists-a-non-ASCII-workflow-at-BOTH-commits-and-classifies-the-edit ``` Without the held fake edits the `--branch` and `ls-tree` ablations also go red, but earlier, on the fake pins, before the real-git rows run.
## Acceptance notes - Every ASCII path reads byte-identically. For a name git quotes, a governed path that read UNGOVERNED now reads governed (the card's defect). Two H-to-S directions follow from reading such a workflow name correctly; both are accepted deviations, recorded here per review record 6893545108: 1. A modified workflow whose name git quotes is classified like any other workflow edit, so a pure `timeout-minutes` edit on it can read Tier S, as the same edit on an ASCII name does. Before, the queue did not see that workflow at all, and a `--branch` / `--pr` reading put it at Tier H by a false reason ("absent at both commits"). 2. A workflow on the merge base whose name git quotes now joins the split's "already in use" inventory (actions and job names), so another workflow's edit that adopts an action used only there can read Tier S where it read H. Before, the quoted listing dropped that file from the inventory. - A path whose first character is a space still loses it in `--branch`, because `tryGit` trims the whole output. No governed prefix starts with a space, so no governed match can change; noted, not changed (the helper is shared). - Path reads in OTHER `scripts/pm/` files without `-z` that feed a tier decision, listed per the order, not fixed here: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `changedPathsFromGit` (`diff --name-only --no-renames` twice and `ls-files --others`, each line trimmed) feeds `--tier`'s path mandate and `--commands`; a `skills/**` path git quotes misses the mandate glob. The other reads found (`check-prior-rulings.mjs`, `check-harness-current.mjs`, `git-history.mjs`, `write-pace.mjs`, `release-rehearsal-clone.mjs`) feed no governed or tier decision. ## Verification - `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate (the diff hits none of the 4 declared globs); default opus; 181 changed lines (+151 / -30), under the 3000 threshold. - `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch` on f1a04f78: NOT governed, 0 of 3 paths hit the register, size 181 ≤ 3000, head repo NOT MEASURED from a branch. - Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) on head f1a04f78, the three-file diff: **42 derived, 42 exit 0** (the new seven, among them `check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, come from the `fleet-write/execute.mjs` path; the round-1 two-file diff derived 35 and did not name it, which is how 35 / 35 sat beside a red head). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 42 accounted for, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. No package is touched, so no build, package test or typecheck is owed; `skip-changeset` (`scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing).
